Fonts of the IYAKKI boot menu (GRUB)                                                  recorded 2026-10-27

iyakki-menu.pf2 and iyakki-term.pf2
  Made at image build time by grub-mkfont (GRUB, GPL-3.0-or-later; the tool is not shipped) from two files that are in the IYAKKI
  repository: DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf and DejaVuSansMono.ttf (crates/iyakki-shell/assets). The Latin range only is converted (U+0020-U+024F
  and U+00A0-U+00FF). Licence: the Bitstream Vera Fonts licence with the DejaVu public-domain changes; the full text is at the end of this
  file. The converted fonts keep the name "DejaVu ..."; the Vera licence only forbids the names "Bitstream" and "Vera" for modified fonts.

unicode.pf2
  GRUB's wide Unicode font (GNU Unifont, converted to GRUB's .pf2 format by grub-mkfont), copied from the build machine's grub2-common
  package or from the Buildroot host tree (the exact path and sha256 are written below by post-image.sh). GNU Unifont is distributed by
  its authors under the GNU GPL version 2 or later with the GNU font embedding exception, and also under the SIL Open Font License 1.1
  (https://unifoundry.com/unifont/). Either way the file may be redistributed with the boot loader. NOT VERIFIED: that licence statement is
  the authors' as known to the project author; the licence file of the particular package the build machine used was not read (Ubuntu's
  grub2-common ships the font without a separate copyright entry for it). The owner decides whether to accept this or to drop
  unicode.pf2 (the menu then uses the two DejaVu fonts for Latin text).

Nothing here is an IYAKKI-made font. Apache-2.0 does not apply to these files.
